description.value: Launched in 2021 as North America's first bunny cafe, The Bunny Cafe is a therapeutic lounge where guests interact with adoptable rabbits in partnership with Rabbitats Rescue Society. The fully vegan menu features plant-based sweet and savory snacks alongside coffee, and the space doubles as a retail shop with rabbit-themed merchandise. A touring cyclist visiting Vancouver's Commercial Drive neighbourhood will find a genuinely one-of-a-kind rest stop that also supports rabbit rescue and adoption.
